# AgentIC

AgentIC is an AI-powered VLSI design agent that automates RTL-to-GDSII chip design flows using local EDA tools and Process Design Kits (PDKs). It bridges large language models with local Electronic Design Automation tools for autonomous silicon design.

## What it does
- Writes, lints, and auto-repairs Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL
- Runs synthesis (Yosys, Design Compiler, Genus), simulation (Verilator, iverilog, VCS, Xcelium), and STA (OpenSTA, PrimeTime, Tempus)
- Executes physical design (OpenROAD, Innovus, ICC2) and physical verification (Magic, KLayout, Netgen, Calibre)
- Supports analog/mixed-signal SPICE flow (ngspice, xschem, Spectre, Eldo)
- Generates interactive Yosys schematics, waveform viewers, PDK catalog, DRC/LVS dashboards
- Auto-checkpoint engine parses EDA logs and returns structured pass/fail verdicts
- Maintains a durable design-state ledger and capability graph for grounding

## Supported PDKs
- SkyWater Sky130 (open source, via volare/Open_PDKs)
- GlobalFoundries GF180MCU (open source)
- ASAP7 (open source research)
- Nangate45 (open source reference)
- Any proprietary PDK (TSMC, Intel, Samsung) via local installation

## Platforms
- Windows (via WSL for EDA tools), Linux, macOS
- Desktop app (Electron-based) with local Python backend
- Local-first: chip source code and IP never leave the user machine

## Pricing
- Starter and Pro plans via subscription
- License verification through signed entitlements
- Download at https://buildstack.live/agentic/download
